tr.title: Bitcoin Opsiyonları Sonuçlanıyor, XRP ETFleri Alım Artıyor
tr.body:
Bitcoin piyasalari, bu Cuma gerceklesecek 6,4 milyar dolar degerinde opsiyon sona erme olayina yaklasiyor. CoinDesk'in raporuna gore, bu surec bitcoin’in 62.000 dolardan 80.000 dolara yukselisi sonrasi piyasa yapicilarinin riskini artirabilir.

Bu hafta kripto piyasalarinda farkli gelismeler birlesiyor: Bitcoin’in buyuk opsiyon sona ermesi, XRP bazli yatirim fonlarininalim akisinin devamini, Japonya’nin blok zincir tabanli menkul kimmet tasfiye sistem plani, stablecoin çekimiyle ilgili yeni duzenleme önerisi ve Güney Kore’deki Shinhan Bankasi’nin Visa ile iş birligi.

CoinDesk'in verisine gore, Cuma gunu 6,4 milyar dolar degerinde bitcoin opsiyonu sona erecek. Bu surec, varligin 62.000 dolardan 80.000 dolara tirmanisi sonrasi piyasa yapicilarinin pozisyonlarini yönetmesi gerektigini anlatiyor. Analistler, bu tip buyuk sona ermelerin kisa vadeli volatiliteyi artirabilecegini belirtiyor.

U.Today'nin haberine gore, ABD’nin spot XRP ETF’leri 25 Agustos’taki is gununde 23,87 milyon dolar netto alim gostererek ardışik gun sayisini dokuza cikardi. Toplam netto alim artık 1,59 milyar dolara ulasmis ve daha genis kripto piyasasında gorulen satis baskisina ragmen bu trend devam ediyor.

CoinDesk’in baska bir raporu, Japonya duzenleyicilerinin erken 2030’li yillarinda hisse senedi ve devlet tahvilleri icin blok zincir tabanli bir tasfiye agini devreye sokmayi planladigini gosteriyor. Amac, yerel ve yabanci sermayenin uluslararas platformlara kaymasini onlemek ve mevcut finansal altyapiyi modernize etmek.

CryptoSlate tarafindan yayinlanan bir yaziya gore, Amerika’nin banka lobisi, stablecoin sahiplerinin nakit yapmadan once bir hesap acmasini zorunlu kılmak istiyor. Blockchain Association bu teklifle, tek islem veya ara yonlendirilmiş nakit cikislari kapsam disi birakip, duzenleyicilere kendi kendine tutulan varliklarin issuer musterisi olarak sayilip sayilmayacagini belirletmeyi amacliyor.

The Block’in haberine gore, Guney Kore’nin Shinhan Bankasi, Visa’nin stablecoin platformunu gelecek finans projeleri icinde kullanacak. Ikisi de stablecoinlerin kart odemeleri, yapay zeka destekli odeeme modelleri ve B2B ile B2C islemlerinde denenecegini acikliyor.

Piyasa verileri gostereki, opsiyon sona erme tarihine yaklasirken bitcoin is hacmi genellikle artar ve bu durum fiyat dalgalanmalarini tetikleyebilir; ayni anda XRP’nin alim akisi devam ettigi surede tokenin fiyatı goreceli olarak dengeli seyrediyor.


#Bitcoin #XRP #Binance
Sources: CoinDesk, U.Today, CoinDesk, CryptoSlate, The Block

en.title: Bitcoin Options Expiry Nears as XRP ETFs See Steady Inflows
en.body:
Bitcoin markets are approaching this Friday’s $6.4 billion options expiry event. According to CoinDesk, this follows bitcoin’s rise from $62,000 to $80,000, which could increase market makers’ exposure.

This week crypto markets see a mix of developments: a large Bitcoin options expiry, continued inflows into XRP‑based ETFs, Japan’s plan for a blockchain‑based stock and bond settlement system, new stablecoin cash‑out rules proposed by US bank lobbies, and Shinhan Bank’s partnership with Visa on a stablecoin platform.

CoinDesk reports that on Friday $6.4 billion worth of bitcoin options will expire. After the asset’s climb from $62,000 to $80,000, market makers will need to manage their positions, and analysts say such large expiries can boost short‑term volatility.

U.Today notes that U.S. spot XRP ETFs recorded $23.87 million in net inflows on August 25, marking the ninth consecutive day of inflows. Total net inflows now stand at $1.59 billion, a trend that persists despite a broader crypto market sell‑off.

Another CoinDesk piece says Japanese regulators aim to launch a blockchain settlement network for stocks and government bonds in the early 2030s, seeking to keep domestic and foreign capital from moving offshore and to modernize the national settlement infrastructure.

CryptoSlate reports that the US bank lobby, represented by the Blockchain Association, wants stablecoin holders to open an account before cashing out, seeking to exclude one‑off and intermediary‑routed redemptions and to clarify when self‑custody users become issuer customers.

The Block writes that South Korea’s Shinhan Bank will use Visa’s stablecoin platform for “future finance” initiatives, testing stablecoins in card payments, AI‑driven payment models, and B2B as well as B2C transactions.

Market data show that bitcoin trading volume tends to rise as an options expiry approaches, which can trigger price swings; meanwhile, XRP’s price has remained relatively steady during its inflow streak.


#Bitcoin #XRP #Binance
Sources: CoinDesk, U.Today, CoinDesk, CryptoSlate, The Block
